Subject: Missing retro payout and VAT allocation (merchant ID CP-4492)

Hi Soojin,

We noticed a missing retroactive payout for May (merchant CP-4492) on Redwood's May 29 settlement. The marketplace settlement shows a gross payout of €46,125 but our ledger only received €41,612 after what appears to be a withholding/fee adjustment and VAT reclassification. Can you confirm what led to the €4,513 delta and share the reconciliation evidence your team used when issuing the payout?

Specifically we need: 1) the marketplace payout_id for May-29 (so we can match in our bank feed), 2) any retro-rate adjustments or negative invoice references, and 3) any VAT remapping that caused EU VAT to be withheld versus passed through to sellers.

Attaching our internal payout statement for May. Please advise — we are on a close timeline with our finance team.

Thanks,
Alex Mercer
Head of Revenue Operations
CloudPeak Solutions

- There’s also a VAT reclassification entry flagged by our EU tax flow for that seller (reason: VAT pass-through vs. withholding re-eval).

We need to gather the underlying docs from the accounting ledger and the tax evidence bundle. I’m looping in Marissa (reconciliations) and Jonas (tax evidence) to pull the invoice stub and the marketplace negative-invoice reconciliation bundle.

Could you please confirm the bank trace ID for the May receipt you have and the exact ledger timestamps you matched to? That will speed things up.

I’ll follow up with a consolidated packet by EOD Wednesday (22 Jul).

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2026 16:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Missing retro payout and VAT allocation (merchant ID CP-4492) — reconciliation outcome

Alex — summary and next steps after review: thank you for the bank trace and VAT cert. We pulled the ledger and here’s what we found: 

Summary (concise):
- Marketplace negative invoice RWI-INV-20260529-CP4492 (-€4,800) was applied on 2026-05-29 due to a retro-rate correction for overpaid credits to the seller. That adjustment decreased gross payable.
- Separately, a tax hold was flagged by CloudPeak on 2026-05-27 (CP-TAX-2118); our tax engine reclassified certain lines from VAT pass-through to withheld VAT pending seller documentation, which created the visible mismatch.
- Net effect: gross €46,125 - negative invoice €4,800 = €41,325. Payment posted as SEPA (TRACE-CP-0529-88) but currency rounding/fees explain the remaining €287 delta versus your bank statement.

Deliverables attached to this thread: RWI-INV-20260529-CP4492.pdf (invoice stub), payout-ledger-05-25-05-31.csv (ledger slice), tax-reclass-audit.log.txt (audit trail snippet).

Proposed remediation:
- If CloudPeak confirms the seller will supply valid VAT documentation for CP-4492 within 10 business days, Redwood will reverse the tax reclassification and issue a corrective credit memo (credit reference: RWI-CM-20260730-CP4492) to restore the €4,800 where appropriate.
- If documentation is not provided, the negative invoice stands; we will issue a detailed settlement note for your records and close CP-TAX-2118.

Please confirm which path CloudPeak prefers. If you want an interim micro-payment for the difference while seller provides docs, we can evaluate but would need exec approval (cc: Grace for approval path).

Thanks — I’ve attached the reconciliation packet to the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/CP-654321

— Marissa
Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: RWI-INV-20260529-CP4492.pdf; payout-ledger-05-25-05-31.csv; tax-reclass-audit.log.txt
